banner.pendingEvidence_one: {{count}} insurer reply is waiting for your confirmation.
banner.pendingEvidence_other: {{count}} insurer replies are waiting for your confirmation.
banner.plansMissing_one: {{count}} live policy without a payment plan: it is not in Collections and sends no reminders.
banner.plansMissing_other: {{count}} live policies without a payment plan: they are not in Collections and send no reminders.

empty.current: No current plans with a balance
empty.upcoming: No installments due in the next 30 days

board.emptyHint: Installments reach Collections once a policy has its payment plan.
board.tabsHelp: Upcoming and Overdue list installments; Current and Settled list whole payment plans. An upcoming installment of a current plan appears in both, so the counts do not add up.

cards.unconfirmedHint: Recorded, not yet confirmed by the insurer

debit.description: Record that the insurer reported the automatic charge (PAC or PAT) was rejected. Any existing payment is reversed with that reason and the installment is flagged as rejected.

description: Every installment in your book, sorted by urgency: upcoming, overdue, current and settled.

evidence.description: Insurer replies and receipts waiting for your confirmation before a payment is recorded.
evidence.emptyOpenHint: When an insurer answers an inquiry or reports a payment through its link, it shows up here for you to confirm.
evidence.noInstallment: No installment identified: pick one with “Other installment”.
evidence.noMoneyHint: The insurer does not report a payment: confirming records the reply, with no payment.
evidence.noOtherInstallments: The policy has no other installments.
evidence.pickFirst: Pick the installment first with “Other installment”.
evidence.retargeted: It will be recorded on the installment you picked.
evidence.scoreHint: How sure Radal is about the suggested installment (0–100)
evidence.senderUnverified: This mail does not come from the address we asked. Check with the insurer before confirming.
evidence.title: Replies to confirm
evidence.unknownAmountHint: If the insurer confirms the payment, enter the amount to record it; without an amount it is only marked as reviewed.
evidence.existingPayments: Payments already booked on this installment
evidence.noExistingPayments: No payments booked on this installment.
evidence.alreadySettled: This installment has no balance left. If the payment belongs to another installment, use “Another installment”; an amount booked here will be refused.
evidence.overBalance: Exceeds the installment balance ({{balance}}): book at most the balance.
evidence.clpOverBalance: At today's UF it exceeds the installment balance ({{balance}}). Check the amount before confirming.
evidence.allOthersPaid: The policy's other installments are already paid or voided.
evidence.paidDisabledHint: Paid or voided installments are shown disabled.

form.ambiguousAmount: Ambiguous amount: use a comma for decimals (12,345) or type it without dots.
form.noFutureDate: The date cannot be in the future.
form.positiveAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero.

gestion.promiseHint: Optional. With a date, the installment stays promised until that day.
gestion.promisePast: The promise date cannot be in the past.
gestion.whatPlaceholder: E.g.: called the policyholder, pays on Friday

inquiries.cancelBody: The insurer will no longer be able to answer through this inquiry's link. Replies already received are kept.
inquiries.description: Payment-status inquiries sent to insurers and their replies.
inquiries.empty: You have not asked any insurer yet
inquiries.emptyHint: From an installment, use “Ask the insurer”: Radal asks by mail whether it was paid and brings you the reply to confirm.
inquiries.finalReason: The inquiry is {{status}}: it can no longer be resent or cancelled.
inquiries.resendHint: Optional: added to the mail. Resent with the same link for the insurer.
inquiries.resentDraft: Inquiry saved, but the mail did not go out: check the sender in Settings → Mail.
inquiries.title: Insurer inquiries
inquiries.allPaidHint: Every installment in this inquiry is already paid: it will not be sent again.

inquiry.created: Inquiry created; the mail did not go out
inquiry.description: Radal asks the insurer whether these installments are paid, with a link to answer without an account. The reply lands in “Replies to confirm”: nothing is recorded without you.
inquiry.messageHint: Optional. Added to the standard mail.
inquiry.notSentHint: The mail could not be sent. Share the link with the insurer or check the sender in Settings → Mail.
inquiry.toHint: Empty = the collections email on file for the insurer.

ledger.payFromCuotas: To record a payment, open the installment in the Installments block above.

link.description: Create an online payment link for this installment. The payment confirms itself, without going through “Replies to confirm”.

missing.insurer_contact: The insurer's collections email is missing to ask it.
missing.mail_sender: No mail sender is set up (Settings → Mail).
missing.other: A detail is missing for assisted collection.
missing.payer_contact: The policyholder's or payer's email is missing to send reminders.
missing.templates_unapproved: Collection messages are not approved (Settings → Collections).

notice.empty: No reminders sent for this installment yet.
notice.title: Reminders sent

payment.confirmedByInsurerHint: Tick it if you already saw it on the insurer's portal or statement.
payment.fxHint: Converted to UF at the payment date's rate.
payment.receiptNoPermission: You do not have permission to upload documents.
payment.overBalance: Exceeds the installment balance ({{balance}}): book at most the balance.

plan.description: Policyholder reminders, installments, payments and insurer inquiries.
plan.noInquiries: No insurer inquiries for these installments.
plan.offHint: Once collection starts, Radal sends the cadence reminders to the policyholder. It works with any insurer.
plan.pauseDatePast: The resume date cannot be in the past.
plan.pauseHint: Notifications to the account executive stay on during the pause.
plan.title: Plan collection

reminder.noRecipientHint: The policyholder's or payer's email is missing: add it in the policy parties.
reminder.whatsappSoon: WhatsApp is pending Meta's approval: reminders go out by email for now.
reminder.notSent: Notice recorded, but the email did not go out: check Settings → Mail.
reminder.overdueNotDue: The overdue notice becomes available once the installment is past due.
reminder.amountAsked: The notice asks for the balance: {{amount}}

sheet.noEditPermission: You do not have permission to edit collections.
sheet.notNative: Online payment is not available for this insurer.
sheet.title: Installment
sheet.noOnlinePayment: No online payment for this installment: the insured pays following the insurer's instructions (transfer, PAC/PAT or coupon) and can upload the receipt through the link you share.
